title: PointsAssigned
description: Emitted when loyalty points are credited to a customer's account

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance

event_version.description: Semantic version of the event schema

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred

points.description: Number of points credited (always positive in this event)

balance_after.description: Customer's total balance after this assignment

reason.description: Reason for points assignment (e.g. purchase, referral, bonus)

reference_id.description: Optional reference to the source transaction (purchase ID, referral ID)

branch_id.description: Branch where the points were earned

expires_at.description: Expiration date for these points (if applicable)
